title: 竹弓少女战斗动作逐帧生产设计
scope: Only hit/attack/cast E/W; no movement, idle, portrait or other-character writes
identityLocks: 解剖左手持完整长竹弓

E.facing: 朝屏幕右，依据E身份/朝向参考独立绘制
E.body: 目标位于屏幕右。受击时上身向屏幕左退让，回弹向右恢复；射击/施法弓与箭朝右。不得将W图镜像取得E图。

W.facing: 朝屏幕左，依据W身份/朝向参考独立绘制
W.body: 目标位于屏幕左。受击时上身向屏幕右退让，回弹向左恢复；射击/施法弓与箭朝左。不得将E图镜像取得W图。

canvasAndRootContract.anchorNature: Approximate original E/W reference root, not per-frame measured bbox center
canvasAndRootContract.allowedMotion: Body articulation, knees, shoulders, hands, hair and cloth; preserve coherent foot support and native canvas.

eventPolicy: Frame numbers are design candidates only. Confirm actual hit peak/full draw/release from final selected images; client event alignment is not tested.
projectilePolicy: A single physical arrow may be nocked before release. Once released, omit the detached arrow/projectile from character PNG. Spell arrow light, trajectories, rings and particles are separate assets.
productionOrderSuggestion: Establish attack E/W full draw and release candidates
Establish cast E/W full draw and release candidates
Fill actual transitions by group and record real provenance

frames.pose: 保留原待机持弓姿态；胸肩开始轻缩，眉眼受惊，右手离开待机位置向胸前移动。左手仍稳握完整竹弓。
frames.deltaFromPrevious: 从对应方向待机开始，只有胸肩轻缩、右手抬起，双脚地根不平移。
frames.transitionToNext: 相较01，膝盖更屈、右前臂形成保护姿态，头部开始向受力反方向退让。
frames.directionSpecific: 目标位于屏幕右。受击时上身向屏幕左退让，回弹向右恢复；射击/施法弓与箭朝右。不得将W图镜像取得E图。

frames.pose: 屈膝加深，胸口收紧，右前臂横护胸腹；弓臂随身体轻弯，弓身仍完整且不换手，马尾略滞后。

frames.transitionToNext: 相较02，实体箭从箭筒抽出到手中，右肘开始向前回转；手中箭与筒中余箭区分。
